caption:
📖 A comma alone can't join sentences. FANBOYS can.

A comma can join two sentences only if it brings a friend.

✅ Full sentence + , + FANBOYS + full sentence.
✅ No second subject? No comma before "and."
✅ Two full sentences: comma + FANBOYS. One subject, two verbs: no comma.
